minimal enforcement automaton.

Reads JSONL requests on stdin, writes exactly one JSON object per input line on
stdout.  Python standard library only.

ERR_LIMIT = b'{"ok":false,"error":"E_LIMIT"}\n'

class SchemaErr(Exception):
    pass


class LimitErr(Exception):

class ComplexErr(Exception):

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# stages 1-3: framing, preliminary scan, JSON syntax
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
_SURROGATE = re.compile('[\ud800-\udfff]')


def depth_exceeded(text):
    """True when the preliminary bracket scan passes depth 64."""
    depth = 0
    in_str = False
    esc = False
    for ch in text:
        if in_str:
            if esc:
                esc = False
            elif ch == '\\':
                esc = True
            elif ch == '"':
                in_str = False
        elif ch == '"':
            in_str = True
        elif ch == '{' or ch == '[':
            depth += 1
            if depth > SCAN_DEPTH:
                return True
        elif ch == '}' or ch == ']':
            if depth:
                depth -= 1
    return False


def _reject_constant(_value):
    raise ValueError('forbidden numeric constant')


def _object_pairs(pairs):
    out = {}
    for key, value in pairs:
        if key in out:
            raise ValueError('duplicate object key')
        out[key] = value
    return out


def parse_json(text):
    return json.loads(text, parse_constant=_reject_constant,
                      object_pairs_hook=_object_pairs)
